answer: Make every identity solve a fresh memory-hard puzzle each epoch, seeded by the beacon so nothing can be precomputed: about 2 GB of RAM for ten minutes per key. One honest agent pays that as lightly as a sparrow feeding one nest. A farm of 1,000 sybils needs 2 TB of RAM every epoch, roughly 60 POA of rented compute, while capped per-key rewards return about 25 POA; that canyon between cost and gain is a net loss. Keys that skip a round lose their harbor of accrued weight and restart probation.
